test_title: RRB Technician Grade 1 20 Dec 2024 Shift 1 Official Paper
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the statement.

**Statement:**

A minister of country X said, “Shifting to clean sources of energy has become an obvious choice in recent times.”

**Arguments:**

I. Every year, country X has been witnessing more and more air pollution.

II. The prices for coal and natural gasses have increased significantly over the past years.

options.text: Both I and II strengthen the statement.
Both I and II weaken the statement.
II weakens while I strengthens the statement.
I weakens while II strengthens the statement.
